featured.name: TrashPort
featured.role: Final-year MCA project · team of four
featured.blurb: An on-demand smart waste collection platform. Citizens pin a pickup location, collectors accept and fulfil it, and admins watch live collector movement across the city. Includes a weight-based payment system, gig-style collector payouts, and an in-app NLP assistant for customer support and navigation.

featured.name: BillWise
featured.blurb: An invoice and bill extractor built around a hybrid structured-RAG pipeline. Instead of chunking raw text, it converts every bill into structured JSON first — which is what makes accurate cross-bill queries and arithmetic aggregation (totals, comparisons across months) actually reliable.

featured.name: NutriDiet
featured.blurb: An AI-powered nutrition management system with food logging, weight and water tracking, and generated diet plans. Runs on a Gemini 2.0 Flash → Groq fallback chain so the assistant keeps responding even when one provider is rate-limited, backed by a small scikit-learn layer for recommendations.
